caption: The drawing depicts a spinning wheel rendered in shades of brown, suggesting a wooden material. The central focus is the large circular wheel with evenly spaced spokes, attached to a horizontal wooden base supported by three turned, lathe-shaped legs. A crank and handle extend vertically from the right end of the base, and there is a smaller mechanical assembly with a spindle and flyer located near this handle, which is connected to the main wheel by a thin drive band. Beneath the base, a flat pedal is connected to the wheel via a linking rod, allowing operation by foot. The composition is on an off-white background with no additional objects or decorative elements present.
title: Shaker Flax Spinning Wheel
